description: Lists the short tracking links of one webinar: the code, the full short address, the channel it belongs to, the UTM parameters it carries and how often it was clicked. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks which links exist, which one to put into an invitation, or how many clicks a channel brought. Do not use it to create a link (that is wi_create_webinar_link). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
